game.title: Mario Kart World
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Nintendo Switch 2 has no native achievement/trophy system, and Mario Kart World is a Switch 2 exclusive with no release (and therefore no native list) on any other platform. Knockout Tour is a live-service feature: it launched with 8 rallies and has grown to 12 as of update v1.8.0 (Sept 10, 2026) via free content updates, with more plausible in the future. The 'gold trophy in every Knockout Tour rally' trophy deliberately reads 'every current rally' rather than a hard-coded number so it does not break as the roster grows; the count is pinned here for context only. No missable content was found anywhere in the game — every collectible, unlock, and mode is permanently available via Free Roam replay, VS Race, or mode select at any time, so no MISSABLE flags are used. Free Roam's collectible totals (394 P-Switch missions, 200 Peach Medallions, 150 ?-Panels — 744 combined) and the 1,056-entry sticker book are deliberately NOT required in full under Rule 20: thresholds (300 P-Switch missions, 75 ?-Panels, 100 Peach Medallions, 500 stickers) represent substantial, representative engagement with Free Roam without demanding exhaustive completionism, some of which requires advanced techniques (Wall Runs, Rail Rides) on a handful of P-Switches. Full-collection trophies are reserved for the character roster (50) and vehicle roster (40), both moderate, game-defining, non-grindy sets comparable to Mario Kart 8's 'Full Roster' and 'Fully Loaded' trophies. Costume/outfit totals conflict between sources (103 vs. 127), so the costume trophy uses a fixed absolute threshold (20) rather than a fraction of an unverified total. No dedicated lifetime-stats screen (total races, distance, win rate) was confirmed to exist, so no trophy references such a counter directly; cumulative trophies instead rely on menus and counters that were confirmed (cup trophy displays, Free Roam per-category collectible counters, the sticker book, and the roster/vehicle select screens). Online trophies are deliberately modest (a single race win, completing one Knockout Tour) with no VR/rating thresholds, per Rule 13 — online servers are healthy as of September 2026, but a competitive rating climb is not something every future player could reliably achieve. Mario Kart World has no boss encounters, consistent with the entire series, and effectively no plot, so the Special Cup/ending trophy carries no spoiler risk and is not marked secret. No DLC exists as of September 2026, so Rule 14 does not apply and there is no separate dlc array. 200cc does not exist in Mario Kart World as of v1.8.0, so no 200cc-based trophy was designed; Mirror Mode is treated as the game's true hardest-difficulty unlock.

trophies.name: Checkered Flag
trophies.description: Win your first race, in any mode.
trophies.verification: The end-of-race results screen shows a 1st place finish.

trophies.name: First Trophy
trophies.description: Complete your first Grand Prix Cup, at any placement.
trophies.verification: The cup results screen awards a trophy (bronze or better) after the fourth race of a cup.

trophies.name: Seven Cups Deep
trophies.description: Earn at least a bronze trophy in all 7 base Grand Prix cups (Mushroom through Lightning).
trophies.verification: The Grand Prix cup-select screen shows a trophy icon, bronze or better, on all 7 base cups.

trophies.name: Rally Rookie
trophies.description: Complete your first Knockout Tour rally, whether you're eliminated along the way or make it to the finish.
trophies.verification: The Knockout Tour rally-select screen marks the rally as cleared once the final segment ends.

trophies.name: Wildcard Racer
trophies.description: Unlock your first racer through a Kamek transformation during a race.
trophies.verification: The character select screen shows the newly unlocked racer as available instead of a locked silhouette.

trophies.name: Detour Taken
trophies.description: Complete your first P-Switch mission in Free Roam.
trophies.verification: A completion notification appears and the mission is marked done on the Free Roam map.

trophies.name: Arena Victor
trophies.description: Win a Battle Mode match, in any game type.
trophies.verification: The post-match results screen shows your character in 1st place.

trophies.name: Outpacing the Legend
trophies.description: Beat a Nintendo Staff Ghost's time on any course in Time Trial.
trophies.verification: The Time Trial results screen shows your final time ahead of the Staff Ghost's time on that course.

trophies.name: Global Champion
trophies.description: Win a race in Online Race mode.
trophies.verification: The post-race online results screen shows a 1st place finish.

trophies.name: Cross-Continent Survivor
trophies.description: Complete an Online Knockout Tour rally, whether you're eliminated or make it to the finish.
trophies.verification: The online Knockout Tour results screen shows the rally as completed.

trophies.name: Dressed to Drive
trophies.description: Unlock 20 different costumes by eating Dash Food at Yoshi's Diners and food stalls across Free Roam.
trophies.verification: The costume/outfit selection menu shows 20 or more unlocked costumes across your characters.

trophies.name: Golden Grand Prix
trophies.description: Earn a gold trophy in all 7 base Grand Prix cups at 150cc, the game's highest standard engine class.
trophies.verification: The Grand Prix cup-select screen shows a gold trophy on all 7 base cups at 150cc.

trophies.name: Full Grid
trophies.description: Unlock the entire 50-racer roster.
trophies.verification: The character select screen shows all 50 racers available with no locked silhouettes remaining.

trophies.name: Garage Complete
trophies.description: Unlock all 40 vehicles.
trophies.verification: The vehicle select screen shows all 40 vehicles unlocked with no locked slots remaining.

trophies.name: Sticker Collector
trophies.description: Collect at least 500 stickers for your sticker book.
trophies.verification: The sticker book / collection menu shows a total of 500 or more stickers owned.

trophies.name: Panel Puzzler
trophies.description: Activate at least 75 of the ?-Panels scattered across Free Roam.
trophies.verification: The Free Roam map's ?-Panel counter shows at least 75 activated.

trophies.name: Treasure of the Open Road
trophies.description: Collect at least 100 Peach Medallions in Free Roam.
trophies.verification: The Free Roam map's Peach Medallion counter shows at least 100 collected.

trophies.name: Triple Threat
trophies.description: Win a match in all 3 Battle Mode game types: Balloon Battle, Coin Runners, and Bob-omb Blast.
trophies.verification: Post-match results screens show a 1st place finish in each of the three game types at least once.

trophies.name: The Other Side of the World
trophies.description: Find the hidden way into the mirrored version of the Free Roam world.
trophies.verification: Driving into the stained-glass Peach window atop Peach Stadium transitions Free Roam into its mirrored version.

trophies.name: Rainbow's End
trophies.description: Clear the Special Cup and reach the credits.
trophies.verification: Clearing the Special Cup, at any placement and any engine class, plays the ending cutscene and credits.

trophies.name: Knockout King
trophies.description: Earn a gold trophy in every currently available Knockout Tour rally at 150cc.
trophies.verification: The Knockout Tour rally-select screen shows a gold trophy on every available rally at 150cc.

trophies.name: Mirror, Mirror
trophies.description: Unlock Mirror Mode.
trophies.verification: Mirror Mode appears as a selectable engine class on the mode-select screen after its unlock cutscene plays.

trophies.name: Free Roam Devotee
trophies.description: Complete at least 300 P-Switch missions across Free Roam.
trophies.verification: The Free Roam map's P-Switch counter shows at least 300 completed.

trophies.name: Master of the Open Road
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other Mario Kart World trophies are marked earned.
